title: Phase 11 Replication and Prospective Evaluation Summary

prospective_2026_evaluation.reason: Laboratory return ledger terminates at 2025-05-15. Genuine 2026 post-earnings price series are not in database.
prospective_2026_evaluation.outcome_tree_verdict: Outcome F: Data or provenance integrity prevents valid prospective evaluation
prospective_2026_evaluation.justification: The training procedure successfully replicated historically (all primary and secondary criteria satisfied across all 3 seeds). However, prospective evaluation on 2026 returns is data-blocked due to the absence of genuine realized 2026 price trajectories.
